name: JESUS BIDS US SHINE
confidence: read from a public-domain score, unchecked
reviewNotes: The melody line read from the Timeless Truths score of Jesus Bids Us Shine (https://library.timelesstruths.org/music/Jesus_Bids_Us_Shine/, its first score, “Jesus Bids Us Shine (Excell)”, Edwin O. Excell, 1884, not Hackleman’s), whose music it marks public domain; only the tune was taken, not the harmony. Its opening agrees with hymnary.org’s incipit 15555 12177 25555 (https://hymnary.org/tune/jesus_bids_us_shine_excell). No hand fixes. Excell’s dates (1851–1921) and the year 1884 are from https://hymnary.org/tune/jesus_bids_us_shine_excell.
